faces.name: Sin, Spira's Punishment
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever Sin enters or attacks, exile a permanent card from your graveyard at random, then create a tapped token that's a copy of that card. If the exiled card is a land card, repeat this process.

faces.name: Sins of the Father
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Each opponent sacrifices a nontoken creature of their choice.
II — For each opponent, you create a 2/1 red Klingon Warrior creature token with haste.
III — Exile target player's graveyard. Each opponent loses life equal to the number of creature cards exiled this way.

faces.name: Sins of the Past
faces.oracleText: Until end of turn, you may cast target instant or sorcery card from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. Exile Sins of the Past.

faces.name: Sinstriker's Will
faces.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature has "{T}: This creature deals damage equal to its power to target attacking or blocking creature."
